entry; a server-assigned id will be returned after the change is deployed.

tools.description: Add or update a key-value pair in a reference data map.

tools.description: Add IOC entries (IPs, domains, hashes, etc.) to a QRadar reference data set.

tools.name: add_to_reference_table

tools.name: assign_offense
tools.title: Assign Offense
tools.description: Assign a QRadar offense to a user. Use this tool to change offense ownership for triage and investigation.

tools.name: create_ariel_search
tools.title: Create Ariel Search
tools.description:
Create a new asynchronous Ariel search using an AQL query expression or a saved search ID. Returns a UUID search_id string used to monitor status and retrieve results via get_ariel_search_status and get_ariel_search_results.

NOTE: saved_search_id is an INTEGER from list_saved_searches — it is NOT the UUID search_id string returned by this tool or get_ariel_search_status.

IMPORTANT: Before using this tool with a query_expression:
1. Read qradar://aql/fields/events or qradar://aql/fields/flows to get valid field names
2. Read qradar://aql/functions to discover available functions
3. Read qradar://aql/guide for syntax rules and patterns
4. Use validate_aql tool to check query syntax before execution

This workflow prevents errors and ensures queries use correct field names for this QRadar deployment.

tools.name: create_dsm_event_mapping
tools.title: Create Dsm Event Mapping
tools.description:
Create a new custom DSM event mapping in QRadar.

DSM event mappings link raw log source event identifiers to QID records so that
QRadar can classify incoming events. This creates a user-provided (custom) mapping.

tools.name: create_qid_record
tools.title: Create Qid Record
tools.description:
Create a new QID record in QRadar.

QID records define custom event types in QRadar. Creating a QID record allows custom
events from log sources to be classified with a specific name, category, and severity.

tools.name: create_reference_map
tools.title: Create Reference Map
tools.description: Create a new reference data map in QRadar SIEM.

tools.name: create_reference_set

tools.description: Create a new reference data set in QRadar SIEM.

tools.name: create_reference_table

tools.name: delete_ariel_search
tools.title: Delete Ariel Search
tools.description: Delete an Ariel search and its associated results. This discards any collected results and stops the search if it is still in progress. The search is deleted regardless of whether results were saved.

tools.title: Delete Reference Map
tools.description: Delete a reference data map or purge its contents.

tools.name: delete_reference_set

tools.name: delete_reference_table

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.title: Delete Saved Search

Deletion fails with CONFLICT if the search is still referenced by dashboards,

Fetches the current staged hierarchy, removes the entry with the matching id,

Execute a QRadar staged configuration deploy.

Before calling this tool, use get_deploy_status to verify there is not already
an active deployment in progress. After starting the deploy, use
get_deploy_status to monitor progress until completion.

tools.name: dns_lookup
tools.title: Dns Lookup
tools.description:

tools.name: geolocate_ip
tools.title: Geolocate Ip
tools.description:
Get geographic location data for an IP address using MaxMind GeoIP.

IMPORTANT: Only PUBLIC IP addresses can be geolocated. Private/RFC1918 addresses will fail:

tools.description: Retrieve the results of a completed Ariel search. The search must be in COMPLETED status before results can be retrieved. Supports pagination via start and limit parameters to retrieve subsets of large result sets.

tools.name: get_ariel_search_status

tools.description: Retrieve status and metadata for an Ariel search by search ID. Returns search progress, status (WAIT, EXECUTE, SORTING, COMPLETED, CANCELED, ERROR), record count, and other metadata.

tools.name: get_custom_action

tools.name: get_deploy_status

running and after deploy_qradar_config to monitor progress.

They are used to classify events at a granular level in QRadar.

location data.

Returns map configuration, element type, key and value labels, element
